2169-4694-5686-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
You control a permanent that is boosting the toughness of all your creatures by at least 1, or that is giving a creature a +1/+1 counter as it enters the battlefield.
You control at least one additional creature.
2169-4694-5686-7306.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {U}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
The Blood token enters the battlefield as a 0/0 creature due to March of the Machines, and will have its toughness boosted by the permanent specified in the pre-requisites to prevent it from dying.
Repeat.

2281-3817-6495.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2281-3817-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3175-3991-6495.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 3.
3175-3991-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2034-3499-6723-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

5658-6245-6441-7824.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
5658-6245-6441-7824.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
5658-6245-6441-7824.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

624-670-745-1619.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
624-670-745-1619.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Phantasmal Image and Mirrorhall Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phantasmal Image trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mirrorhall Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
624-670-745-1619.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

670-1619-6154-6966.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-6154-6966.description:
Cast All-Fates Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger, exiling White Plume Adventurer until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice All-Fates Stalker.
All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, causing White Plume Adventurer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When White Plume Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning All-Fates Stalker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger, exiling White Plume Adventurer until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice All-Fates Stalker.
Repeat from step 5.

2180-5708-7275.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
2180-5708-7275.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Nearheath Stalker.
Nearheath Stalker dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Vein Ripper
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Nearheath Stalker trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Nearheath Stalker, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

2061-4377-7487.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Zealous Lorecaster.
When the Zealous Lorecaster token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

997-1402-3593-4359.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Diamond Lion from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Diamond Lion by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Garna.
Resolve the Garna ability from step 3, returning all creature cards that were put in your graveyard this turn to your hand.
Repeat.

176-560-5686.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-560-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Queen Allenal of Ruadach.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

4050-4484-6248-6896.easyPrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
4050-4484-6248-6896.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} due to Green Goblin.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {B}.
When Ebondeath dies, Phenomenon Investigators triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3903-6614.description:
Whenever a player casts a spell from their hand, Knowledge Pool triggers, exiling the spell and allowing the player to cast another card exiled by Knowledge Pool without paying its mana cost.
If the player chooses to cast a spell, Vexing Bauble triggers, countering that spell since no mana was spent to cast it.

575-2511-4674.notablePrerequisites: You have a green card in hand.
575-2511-4674.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Temur Charger.
When Temur Charger dies, Yedora triggers, returning Temur Charger from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Temur Charger by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Charger's morph ability by revealing a green card from your hand, turning Temur Charger face up.
Temur Charger triggers, giving target creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound

708-2459-3927-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Sakashima's Protege trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Sakashima's Protege.
Repeat.

803-4094-4508-5880.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
You control another nonland permanent.
803-4094-4508-5880.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

413-500-914-3125-4867.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
413-500-914-3125-4867.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Cormela and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put one of the Cormela tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Cormela that died in step 3 and the Cormela that died in step 4 each trigger, as does Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Cormela triggers, returning Victimize and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Cormela token by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B}, causing you to sacrifice the Cormela token and return Cormela and Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Put the token Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Dockside Extortionist, the token Cormela, and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Cormela trigger, returning up to one instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding four mana.
Repeat from step 2.
If opponents control five or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Timestream Navigator

1061-2665.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
1061-2665.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a copy of Timestream Navigator.
Activate the ability of any Timestream Navigator that has not entered this turn by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it, and putting it on the bottom of your library, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Ojer Axonil, Deepest Might // Temple of Power

2034-2868-5551.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
2034-2868-5551.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Axonil that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lazotep Convert, adding {C}{C}.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Axonil that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Repeat from step 4.

141-2034-5260.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2034-5260.description:
Cast Entering by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Entering.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Entering, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Entering copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2034-5260.notes: You can cast Breaking and Entering fused together to also get infinite mill and self-mill.

1656-2013-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
It is your combat phase.
1656-2013-4762.description:
During your combat phase, activate Necrotic Ooze using Kjeldoran Elite Guard's ability by tapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once Necrotic Ooze has infinite toughness, you may instead use Devoted Druid's first ability to get infinite green mana.

618-2808.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Enduring Scalelord.
618-2808.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Enduring Scalelord with haste.
Put a +1/+1 counter on either Enduring Scalelord.
The Enduring Scalelord who didn't have the counter put on it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat step 3.

4474-4687-4893.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Gilder Bairn.
Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
4474-4687-4893.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

4398-5151.description:
Whenever a player casts an instant or sorcery spell from their hand, Eye of the Storm triggers, exiling that spell.
Because Deafening Silence prevents players from casting more than one noncreature spell each turn, players cannot cast an instant or sorcery spell permitted by Eye of the Storm, or any other noncreature spell that turn.

3129-3456-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Rapacious Dragon.
Rapacious Dragon enters the battlefield, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate three of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1409-2781-4344.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Lumbering Battlement.
1409-2781-4344.description:
Activate Lumbering Battlement by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, causing Felidar Guardian to return to the battlefield.
Felidar Guardian and Lumbering Battlement enter the battlefield, triggering Felidar Guardian's ability, Lumbering Battlement's ability, and Deadeye Navigator's ability twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, choosing not to pair.
Resolve the Lumbering Battlement trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Lumbering Battlement.
Repeat from step 2.
